discoveries.summary:

discoveries.summary: LLMs have advanced rapidly, raising growing concerns about their safety. discoveries.summary: Cooperative multi-agent tasks often impose constraints on a shared objective or collective safety. discoveries.summary: Person re-identification is typically addressed by learning identity-discriminative embeddings from individual person crops.
